market_name: Will 9 Fed rate cuts happen in 2026?

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Check whether the 9-cut probability move coincides with a broader dovish repricing (2yr yield down, front-end fed funds futures) rather than isolated thin-market noise.
time_plan.1h: Compare TLT move to MOVE index and 10yr yield; confirm direction consistency and whether any macro headline (jobs, Fed speaker, geopolitical shock) is driving it.
time_plan.2h: Re-check if the probability spike persists or mean-reverts; assess whether equity/credit markets corroborate a risk-off vs pure-rates story.
time_plan.6h: Evaluate whether the signal has been absorbed into consensus rate expectations (public) already, reducing edge.
time_plan.12h: Assess net TLT move vs prediction; log whether the market led or lagged Treasuries.

predictions.reasoning: Nine 25bp cuts in 2026 (~225bps of easing) is a deep-easing/emergency scenario. A sharp rise in the implied probability of this outcome signals markets pricing recession or crisis-driven Fed capitulation, which pulls the whole rate curve lower and lifts long-duration Treasury prices. TLT is the cleanest liquid proxy for a dovish repricing. However, this is a tail-strike market; probability moves here are noisy and the expected 12h move is well below the 700bp tradable threshold.

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Confirm DXY is softening and real yields falling alongside the probability move.
time_plan.1h: Check if gold move is haven-driven (equities down, VIX up) or rates-driven; distinguish narratives.
time_plan.2h: Watch for reversal if the probability spike was thin-market noise; compare to silver/miners for corroboration.
time_plan.6h: Assess whether dollar weakness sustains and whether any geopolitical headline explains the move publicly.
time_plan.12h: Compare net GLD return to prediction and note lead/lag versus the prediction market.

predictions.reasoning: A jump in odds of aggressive 2026 easing implies lower expected real rates and a weaker dollar, both supportive for gold. Gold also benefits if the driver is crisis/geopolitical (topic tagged military_conflict), adding a safe-haven bid. But the linkage from a tail rate-cut strike to gold is indirect and the move is far below the 700bp tradable bar.

evidence_used: Market resolves on count of 25bp cuts in 2026; 9 cuts implies ~225bps easing, a deep/emergency scenario
Emergency inter-meeting cuts count, so high strikes are tied to crisis/recession outcomes
Standard macro linkage: dovish repricing lowers yields (TLT up), weakens USD, supports gold
Topic tag military_conflict suggests a possible geopolitical/haven driver
uncertainty_notes: Tail-strike prediction markets are thin and noisy; probability moves may not reflect real information
Equity direction is ambiguous: cuts are supportive but a recession/crisis driver is negative
If the move is already reflected in fed funds futures and Treasuries, there is no leaked edge
Magnitude: expected 12h moves are far below the 700bp tradable threshold, so this is research-only, not tradable

llm_justification.summary: A sharp rise in the implied probability of 9 Fed cuts in 2026 would signal a deep-easing or crisis scenario. The cleanest liquid implications are higher long-duration Treasury prices (TLT up) and higher gold (GLD up) via lower real rates and a weaker dollar, with a possible safe-haven overlay given the conflict tag. Both mappings are directionally plausible but modest in magnitude, well under the tradable threshold, and confidence is low because tail-strike markets are noisy and equity direction is ambiguous.
key_assumptions: A probability spike reflects genuine dovish/recession expectations rather than thin-market noise
Standard rates-gold-dollar transmission holds over the 12h window
No offsetting inflation shock that would force the Fed to stay restrictive
failure_modes: The probability move reverses quickly as illiquid tail-strike noise
The information is already public and priced into fed funds futures and Treasuries
TLT/GLD are only weakly exposed if the move is idiosyncratic to the prediction market
Direction inverts if the driver is a hawkish repricing or inflation surprise elsewhere
Expected magnitude never reaches the 700bp bar, so no tradable signal materializes
llm_justification.why_not_ex_post: The card is timestamped, content-hashed, and never overwritten. Execution must reject any card created after an anomaly's trigger time.
